scientific_integrity: The known Gaussian solid-angle identity is credited, not claimed new; the proof of the sharp correction and conditional local law is included. Numerical checks support but do not prove the infinite-dimensional asymptotic. Historical priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-k conditional convergence as dimension grows; no uniform finite-d remainder constant.
Potential unindexed historical treatments of high-dimensional cross-polytope cone angles.
title: A sharp high-dimensional vertex-illumination law for regular cross-polytopes
